scope: Offline sound/hover candidate at both scales; no VLC launch, mouse/keyboard input, or live profile change.
change: Preserve keyed intro pixels; separate non-restarting shutter input gate from static feedback; fit fresh 1x/2x defaults to declared work areas; reset isolated preview layouts through INI writers. Disable media-driven video panel enlargement; compare independent retained WMS/XML layer compositions. Restore source button backings, two-recess video header and static Web Destinations art; remove 2x menu crop filtering seams. Replace lower-right alpha-1 black resize images with exact native-scale original corner crops for all seven palettes. Isolate pane palettes from shutter/clock main layout transitions using persistent hidden palette state; preserve legacy colors through explicit saved-state migration. Fullscreen entry points now toggle native video maximize/restore with the original border and feedback assets; native video double-click remains borderless. Video maximum bounds are 8192x4320. Scale solid fills rather than tile each output pixel; flatten video idle backings onto palette-matched original header crops before native caching. Restore source WAVs through an optional process-scoped Windows helper and original-art native/fullscreen and framed hover bars; ready/trigger layout protocol avoids routine SW_SHOW activation.

regression_evidence: Startup source comparison rejected old frame 15 at 1x before the fix; full startup/light source equality passes at 1x and 2x after correction. Source-art and panel checks also rejected in-memory pixel, hover-binding, button-obstruction and resize-anchor mutations. Animated shutter-idle and offscreen information-window mutations were rejected in memory. Isolated writer tests cover stale layout reset, Unicode/shell-metacharacter paths and failing targets. Video omission/true autoresize mutations rejected; visual residual self-checks detect visible-pixel and shifted-layer mutations while ignoring zero-alpha RGB. The old alpha-1 corner bitmap fails the new source-pixel guard and reproduces a black rectangle in the cached-copy model. Temporal gap tests now reject auxiliary main-layout visibility bindings; adapter mutations removing state migration or reintroducing old pane bindings are rejected.
